title: Hyperbola: Domain, Range, and Transformations
body:
The graph of $g(x) =  rac{a}{x+p} + q$ has asymptotes at $x = -3$ and $y = 2$, and passes through the point $(1, 3)$.

a) Determine the values of $p$ and $q$.
b) Find the value of $a$.
